x.meaning_en: stops on request to set down or to take up passengers

|.note: when several consecutive stations are passed the rule is printed as one long bar spanning those rows; each row is recorded as its own '|' cell

~.meaning_en: does not run daily or runs during a certain period only
~.note: printed as a thin wavy line running down the whole length of a train column, beside the times; the particular rule is then given by a lettered footnote or by a day symbol next to the terminal times
~.quote: to left of times = does not run daily or runs during a certain period only.
